notes.title: DARIUSBURST CS "SCORING CONTEST!"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10954844/f9ef7276cef5a8c52656991e734859f921464e89.png[/img]
To celebrate the [b](DARIUS series  35th Anniversary)[/b], we're holding two simultaneous DBCS score contests!

Start:  20:00 pm PT on October 18th (Mon)
Finish: 23:59 pm PT on October 25st (Mon)

[h3]How to entry[/h3]
Take a screenshot of your score under the specified conditions with the hashtags "#Darius" and "#shmups" and send it to the [b]Degica Games Twitter account (@degicagames)[/b] during the event, or upload a screenshot via Steam Community.

[b]*Update on October 20, 2021
We would like to give a supplementary explanation about the Steam entry method.
When you upload a screenshot on the Steam community, you will need to include the hashtags [b]"#Darius"[/b] and [b]"#shmups"[/b] or text that clearly states that you are participating in this score competition.
If you've already entered, you'll still be counted. [/b]

[h3]Advanced section[/h3]
Rules: In AC Mode > Original Mode > Default Entry, submit a high score online (during the contest time frame) with a route of C, G, and L. You may choose any ship. The top three scores will be awarded the prizes below.

[h3]Beginners section[/h3]
Rules: In AC Mode > Original Mode > Default Entry, submit a high score online (during the contest time frame) with a route of A, D, and H. You may choose any ship. The top three scores will be awarded the prizes below.

[b]*Update on October 21, 2021
As long as you cleared the route under the specified route and conditions, you can enter the contest as many time as you like.
We do not plan to count by aircraft, and each user will only be counted for "one" highest score for clearing the designated route.
Thank you again for your understanding.[/b]

[h3]Prizes:[/h3]
(Note!: DLC requires the original game to function! Prizes will be provided as Steam keys.)

Advanced section
First Place: Steam point card $100
Second Place: Steam point card $50
Third Place: Steam point card $25

Beginners section
First Place: All current ship DLC bundles!
Second Place: The Darius Odyssey Digital Guidebook and your choice of two current ship DLC bundles!
Third Place: Your choice of one current ship DLC bundle!

Furthermore, 5 winners will be drawn from the Beginners section, and you can choose 1 ship DLC bundle as your prize!

Good luck!

* excluding The Darius Odyssey Digital Guidebook

notes.title: DARIUSBURST Chronicle Saviours Rev. 6694: CHRONICLE SAVIOURS fix
notes.notes:

That's right: thanks to phenixcore's patience and cooperation, you can now become Chronicle Saviours! In other words, the final achievement has now been fixed.

NB: we still want to fix the corrupt save data bug: if you come across it, *do not* erase the data, instead check this post out and send it over to us so we can fix it: http://steamcommunity.com/app/377870/discussions/0/3182216552779116762/

notes.title: DariusBurst CS: Important Notice Corrupt Save Data & CS Mode Points
notes.notes:
In attempting to fix this issue, we have a request for all users affected by the save data corruption bug which erases the CS points and purchased ships in CS Mode. 

We would like users to send corrupted save data to us in order that we can investigate and address whatever is causing this issue. Instructions as to how to do this follows.

[b]How to find & save corrupted save data[/b]
[olist]
[*]When save data is corrupted, the game will display an error message.
[*]You will be asked whether to erase/format the save data; choose 'No'
[*]Return to Windows and locate your save data (details below)
[*]Zip the contents of the save data folder and email it here: games@degica.com
[*]When emailing, please use the following title: "DariusBurst CS Corrupted Save Data"
[/olist]

[b]Save Data locations[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam default install:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata\User ID(*)\377870\remote
[*]Steam custom install:
your chosen file path here\userdata\User ID(*)\377870\remote
[/list]
* 'User ID' is your individual Steam ID number.

Apologies again for the inconvenience, but we appreciate any help you can offer in fixing this issue.
